acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc:
Host Ira Glass walks through a Kansas City, Missouri amusement park called Worlds of Fun with Cole Lindbergh, who had a season pass to the park as a little kid, started working there in the summers at 14, and then stayed on. Now he's a full-time, year-round employee who runs the games department. He may do this job better than anyone in the country.
Watch Ira explain why he related to Cole more than anyone he's ever done a story about.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
Ira continues with Cole Lindbergh and the teenagers who work for him in the games department at Worlds of Fun. We watch them compete against each other to see who can do the most business.
Cole's Worlds of Fun videos mentioned in Act One:
Play My Games Music Video
I'm in a Game Music Video (The sequel: note how it starts where Play My Games ends)
Training Video
Sci Fi Special Effects Film (Yes, there's a two minute credit sequence/prologue before the action starts)
Others!
acts.title: Gameboy Grows Up

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
We asked for your stories about amusement parks. Three hundred of you
called in, with stories of fear, floating carnies and, um, vomit.
acts.title: Great Adventures

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc:
Jonathan Goldstein returns to Wildwood, New Jersey, where he spent one not-fateful summer when he was sixteen.
Jonathan's the host of the podcast Heavyweight.
acts.title: What I Didn't Do on My Summer Vacation
